fusions.name: Sounding Tap
fusions.desc: Raps the ground, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Belfry Burst
fusions.desc: Sends bats at the first enemy it meets, which deals 28 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Whispering Gallery
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is reflected back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Roofline Grotesque
fusions.desc: A bonded grotesque fights beside you. Every 1.3 seconds it strikes an enemy within 4.5 tiles and deals 4 damage.
